ok do it. give me the new key now and how to test quickly

messages.content: hi — i tried to apply coupon SAVE20SEP at checkout but it keeps saying "Coupon invalid or expired." Order ID: ORD-2026-09-08-4571. Email: maria.gonzalez@example.com. My renewal was processed today (2026-09-08). can you help?

Hi Maria — I'm Liam from StreamFlow Support. Sorry for the hassle. I can look into this for you. Can you confirm: (1) which device/browser you used to apply the code (web, iOS, Android), (2) the plan type (Basic/Standard/Premium), and (3) the last 4 digits of the card on file so I can pull the correct billing record?
Hi Liam — web (Chrome on Windows 10). Plan is Basic Monthly ($9.99). Last 4 of card: 1234. I got the promo in your newsletter on Aug 28 and it said valid through Sep 30, so i'm surprised it failed.

Thanks for those details — I found order ORD-2026-09-08-4571 and your account. I see the promo code SAVE20SEP in our campaign system; however the terms for that specific coupon were set to "new customers only" (applies to first 2 billing cycles). Because your account was created on 2026-07-15, the system blocked it at checkout and returned the "invalid/expired" message. I can do two things right now if you’d like: (A) issue a one-time account credit equal to 20% of today's charge (rounded to $2.00) which will be applied immediately to your account balance, and (B) add a manual 20%-off promotion to your account so your next renewal on 2026-10-08 also receives 20% off. The credit will show in your StreamFlow account immediately and as a refund on your bank statement within 3-5 business days. May I proceed with that?
yes please proceed. that sounds fair. thanks.

Done — I applied a $2.00 one-time account credit to your account for order ORD-2026-09-08-4571 and added a manual promo (internal code: MANUAL-SAVE20) to your profile to automatically apply 20% off your next renewal on 2026-10-08. Reference numbers: Support Ticket #100342, Refund Reference REF-4571-09. I also triggered an email confirmation to maria.gonzalez@example.com. You should see the $2.00 credit immediately under Account > Billing > Account Credits. The bank refund (if you prefer a direct card refund) will post to your card within 3-5 business days — the account credit is instant for use on StreamFlow. Sorry again for the confusion; I've also left a note on the account explaining why the manual adjustment was made.
omg that was fast, thank you. i'll check now. quick question — will this do anything weird to my billing date or future charges?

No change to your billing date — it remains 08 of each month (next one: 2026-10-08). The manual promo just reduces the billed amount for that next cycle. Numbers to expect: basic monthly is $9.99; 20% off is $2.00, so your next invoice will show a promotion line for -$2.00 and a net due of $7.99 (plus any applicable taxes). The one-time $2.00 credit we applied just reduced today's net charge/was issued as account credit. If anything looks different on 2026-10-08 I'll re-open this ticket and fix it right away.
i can see the $2.00 credit in my Billing page now. phew. also FYI i tried the coupon earlier in your mobile app and there wasn't a field to enter it — maybe that's why it looked broken to me.

Thanks for the heads-up — on sign-up flow we do show a coupon field, but for existing accounts the mobile app currently doesn't expose a 'Redeem promo' field which can be confusing. I've added a product ticket (PT-789) and included your feedback and device info (iOS/Android or app version if you want to share). For now, the manual promo is applied to your account, so you won't need to enter anything in the app. If you ever want to verify, go to Account > Billing > Payment History and you'll see the promo line on the invoice. Anything else I can check while I'm here?
nope that's everything. thanks a lot liam — you saved me a headache :)

You're very welcome, Maria. I also sent a confirmation email with subject "Credit applied & promo added - Ticket #100342" to maria.gonzalez@example.com; if you don't see it in your inbox within 15 minutes, please check Spam. The ticket will remain open for 72 hours and I’ll follow up if the refund or promo doesn't post correctly. If anything else comes up, reply to that email or tell us the ticket number. Enjoy streaming!
got the email. one tiny follow-up — the email shows promo code MANUAL-SAVE20. will i need to type that in somewhere or is it automatic?

The MANUAL-SAVE20 entry is linked to your account and will be applied automatically to your next invoice; you don't need to type anything. It's included in the email in case you ever switch to a different account or need a reference. If you prefer, I can also convert it to a redeemable code that you could apply manually, but that isn't necessary for your current setup.
ok perfect. appreciate how clear you were and how quickly you fixed it. thanks again 🙂
Glad I could help, Maria — enjoy the new episodes (Neon Trails S2 dropped today!). If anything else comes up, we're here. Have a great evening.
that's awesome — i'll binge it tonight. thanks liam, seriously saved my day!
